o.text: Calque of Persian تاب آوردن (literally “to bring endurance”).
Borrowed from Arabic دِيَار (diyār), a plural form of دَار (dār).

Most likely borrowed from Ottoman Turkish تتك (tetik), reflecting the historical spread of firearms from Ottoman Turkey to Safavid Iran. Ultimately derived from Proto-Turkic *tet-, thus related to didmək.
